edges.design_contract: Source: particular exposed route and shipment. Methods: Merchant chooses risk/escrow/delay; Hound provides observed hazard assessment or escort. Result: source-specific exposure difference, never fabricated robbery or guaranteed safety.

Source: mundane candles, paper, glass and experimental apparatus. Methods: Merchant legitimately supplies goods; Mystic records what study they enable. Result: actual material trade only. Blocked: priced prophecy guarantees and magical item effectiveness.

Source: booked show, physical stage goods and actual route. Methods: Wanderer carries/guides; Performer chooses location and program. Result: real event readiness or justified cancellation/alternative after route change.

Source: district surveys and bridge/river clues. Methods proposed: Wanderer contributes signed firsthand route context; Detective examines case implications and preserves custody. Result: stronger time/location evidence without conflating logistics with solved mystery. Formal handoff unverified.

Source: shared four-site survey and physical route condition. Methods proposed: Wanderer measures passability/logistics; Hound evaluates threat, patrol and rescue. Result: distinct public choices about the same underlying road. Prevent duplicate survey in different costumes.

Source: real accessible churchyard or unusual landmark at a certain time. Methods: Wanderer guides and witnesses route, Mystic studies. Result: valid arrival/study record; blocked special occult sensing or exclusive ritual route rules.

Source: timed witnessed show, audience observations and backstage objects. Methods: Performer accounts for rehearsal/show schedules; Detective tests alibi or misleading witness memories through permissioned access. Result: qualified evidence; no backstage omniscience.

Source: real public show near observed hazard. Methods: Hound warns/escorts from known risk; Performer chooses schedule, route and voluntary crowd handling. Result: cancellation, adaptation or safer event with witnessed consequences.

edges.design_contract: Source: folklore recital, staged séance or genuine observed oddity. Methods: Performer knows the theatrical means employed; Mystic documents any actual phenomenon independently. Result: interpretive ambiguity, not automatic proof of a reading.

Source: tracks, disturbed scene, suspected incident. Methods: Hound secures path/traces and protective actions; Detective maintains custody and competing explanations. Result: preserved or lost evidence, safe late-arrival traces, reasoned disagreements, no rival combat class.

Source: alleged haunting with scene conditions and witness reports. Methods: Detective looks for staged/physical explanations; Mystic chooses documented observation. Result: multiple hypotheses; blocked prophecy or reading as truth test.

Source: anomaly-adjacent tracks and exposed observation site. Methods: Hound assesses physical safety; Mystic records methods/interpretations. Result: actual patrol and study records; blocked supernatural protection and ritual failure rules. 10.1 Completeness audit rule Do not upgrade S, D or C by design review alone. An edge becomes verified only if at least one ordinary player can discover the source, both distinct roles can act, the authoritative object changes, negative and solo paths work, witness limits hold, and two-account + restart + uncoached evidence exists. V still needs gameplay/comprehension testing beyond regression.
